jobs.title: Stakeholder Relations Coordinator
jobs.notes: A new role running NKT's presence at big public and political events like Folkemødet, Almedalen, Wind Europe and the UN COPs, building relationships with NGOs, interest groups and political stakeholders for the green electrification agenda. English is the requirement and Danish only a plus. Lead with Nordic Fintech Week and your 20+ community partners; the honest gap is policy knowledge, so show curiosity for energy politics. Deadline 29 November.

jobs.title: Head of Global Events & Community
jobs.notes: Their first events and community hire at a Series A scale-up: 15 to 20 events a year, sponsorships, speakers, VIP dinners and a flagship customer event. That is very close to what you did at Copenhagen Fintech, and the Head title should land at or above your 40,000 target. The gap is that they ask for 3 to 6 years in B2B SaaS event marketing tied to sales pipeline, so lead with your 50+ events and sponsor work and frame them in results.

jobs.title: Congress Strategy & Execution Manager
jobs.notes: End to end planning of global medical congresses: budgets, vendors, project teams and onsite delivery, with a salary range well above your target. The gap is that it is big pharma and medical congresses rather than your startup world, and they want 3 to 4 years of complex events. Lead with Nordic Fintech Week logistics and budgets.

jobs.title: Culture Specialist
jobs.notes: An electric mobility company building its European team wants someone to run employee events, newsletters and an ambassador community across markets. English-first and asks for 2 to 4 years. The gap is that the audience is internal staff, not an external community, and the title may pay below 40,000.

jobs.title: Sr. Marketing Specialist - Exhibitions, Events & Live
jobs.notes: Fully remote role planning solar and renewable energy trade fairs and conferences across Europe, so climate impact plus the event work you know. The gaps: they prefer someone based in Spain, want a second European language (German preferred) and solar experience is a plus. Your Portuguese and Bulgarian count as languages.

jobs.title: Marketing Activation Manager, GJRC
jobs.notes: Brand activations for Georg Jensen and Royal Copenhagen with wholesale partners across EMEA, English-first in a design and creative setting. The gap is that it is trade and customer marketing with a sales focus, which you have not done. Deadline 21 November.

jobs.title: Partnership Officer for Driving Strategic Industry Collaboration and Research Funding within Energy - DTU Offshore
jobs.notes: Building industry partnerships and research funding for offshore energy at DTU, real partnerships work with a climate angle. The gap is that they want several years in the energy sector or research, so this is a stretch unless you can link your ecosystem work to industry funding.
